remarks: Discover inviting indoor-outdoor living in this beautifully upgraded two-story home in the lush Sycamore Creek neighborhood featuring 4 bedrooms and 2.5 baths, offering an inviting pool, spa and BBQ are with framed lush landscaping and classic brick hardscape. Designer tile enhances the first floor, where a spacious living room with a vaulted ceiling flows into the formal dining room. The kitchen features white cabinetry, granite countertops, Jenn-Air appliances, a large pantry, a breakfast bar, and a bay window overlooking the stunning backyard.
